# discord_user (Data Source)

Reads a Discord user by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_user" "alice" {
  id = "222222222222222222"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Snowflake ID of the user to read.

### Read-Only

- `avatar` (String) The user's avatar hash.
- `bot` (Boolean) Whether the user is a bot.
- `discriminator` (String) The user's legacy discriminator.
- `global_name` (String) The user's display (global) name.
- `username` (String) The user's username.
